svg.title: The flight loop as wm-flight-wiring.edn declares it
svg.text: The flight loop as the wiring map declares it
Generated from holes/labs/M-wm-wiring/wm-flight-wiring.edn (db5da3a5, futon3c HEAD 2f7e3465) by spike/wm_wiring_svg.bb; not hand edited. 149 boxes, 129 fields.
Each panel is one step of the flight, in order. A box is a source var the map pins, listing what it writes (w) and reads (r). A field kept inside a step is an arrow inside its panel.

A field that crosses steps is one line in the band below, tapped by its writer (dot) and each reader (arrow). The registered test checks each site at the pins (futon2 0ed71d6d471501eb548b345cf5133a50b01e5d8b, futon3c ebe40c9127cd7129d49f4cc0e307b6750ea2b8e6), expecting 469 findings (75 to-do). 47 fields cross steps; 0 of 11 steps are entered or left by none.

svg.text: solid box: built component at its pinned var (126)
dashed amber box: declared, not built, drawn at its intended site (0)
dotted box: the step's registered test, a declared reader; it lists its reads and draws no arrows (23)
grey box: siteless component, exempt from conformance (1)
line: a field, from its one writer to its readers, both built (136 reader arrows; 47 fields cross steps, 65 stay inside one)
dashed amber: declared on a box not yet built (0)
purple: the reader is an earlier step than the writer, the loop closing (15)
grey stub: a field read that no box writes (4); green stub: the owner's text, exogenous (2)

Numbered rings: the exemplar trace the map records for M-autoclock-in, in order (loop-entry > r1-outer-cascade > flight-entry > dispatch > clock-in > r2-served-by-reading > r2-verifier > r6-cascade-lane > r9-selection-law > r0-enact-step > r7-flight-call > wc-checker > r7-increment > r7-fold > r1-outer-cascade). Boxes on it have a heavier border.

What this does not show: the prover reads sites textually, so a field's presence at a var is what is checked, not that the value flows; remaining attribution limits are recorded in the map and WM-MAP-REPLAY-D; recognising a binding does not certify a hand-off. Standing findings (394) are generic keys the prover cannot scope per box.

A red chevron in the hand-off strip is a boundary no declared field crosses in the flight's direction; the code hands data across it through the flight record and the store's published view, which no box carries yet.
A step marked as entered or left by no field is one whose inputs and outputs the map does not yet declare; that is a gap in the map, not in the drawing.
Organisation: who calls whom, in order (from the source, at futon2 0ed71d6d)

Each box once, under its first caller in flight order; siblings in body order (numbered). 124 placed, 220 calls (201 direct, 7 hand-off invocations, 3 hand-checked cross-process, 9 closure constructions), 144 with a condition (printed on the edge). 101 callers placed elsewhere are thin grey arcs.

Generated by spike/wm_org_layer.bb at map db5da3a5 (wm-org-layer.edn); its three hand-checked edges' evidence sites are re-verified on every run. Lanes derived from this order disagree with the panels' hand-kept lane table for 19 boxes (listed at the foot).
hand-off: a closure the caller was handed, invoked
builds a closure another box invokes

g.title: clock-in — futon3c/src/futon3c/agency/clock_lineage.clj persist-clock! full_loop_runner/dispatch! POSTs /api/alpha/bell with :mission-id (cross-JVM HTTP); in futon3c, agency/clock_decision.clj:293 calls clock_lineage/persist-clock!. The hop from the bell to the clock decision is not traced here: this edge is the map's :traces hop, not a read of the path

click-start — futon3c/src/futon3c/transport/http.clj handle-wm-click-start http-click-fn POSTs /api/alpha/wm/click (flight_runner.clj:495-511, cross-JVM HTTP); futon3c transport/http.clj:9295 routes the POST to handle-wm-click-start

wc-checker — futon3c/holes/labs/M-futon-seams/exemplar/proof2a_check.clj siteless (futon3c holes/labs/M-futon-seams/exemplar/proof2a_check.clj); wc-verdict-fn runs it as a bb subprocess (flight_runner.clj:915-922, :checker opt; the map's :traces hop r7-flight-call -> wc-checker)
